creator: I-Cheng Yeh
source_population: Existing Taiwan credit-card clients observed in a single 2005 cohort
source_note: April-September payment/bill history precedes next-month default label; no independent lending vintages or observed intervention outcomes
derived_artifacts_attribution: Derived partition and historical prediction artifacts retain UCI attribution and CC BY 4.0 source terms; original code retains its MIT notice

historical_study.preregistration_limit: Protocol, implementation and results first appear together in Git; a separate pre-outcome protocol commit is not established

replay_policy.scientific_design: Preserve original fixed models, duplicate-group partitions, calibration and validation-selected thresholds
replay_policy.exact_checks: Source/protocol/reference bytes, row/group identities, partition membership, integer counts and artifact hashes
replay_policy.new_queue_extension: Postpublication descriptive capacity scenarios; ranking probabilities descending and source IDs ascending, floor(capacity*n); no new untouched holdout
